visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short hair and round-framed glasses is seated in the back of a moving car. She is wearing a black blouse with intricate lace sleeves and a blue wristband that says 'DRX' on her right arm. She holds a glass bowl containing a mix of oatmeal-like substance and uses a silver spoon to eat while looking toward the window. The car interior is dark gray leather with natural light coming from the window showing a blurred urban street. (2) A close-up view of the glass bowl shows the texture of the food, which appears to be yogurt mixed with chia seeds and fruit. Text overlays appear sequentially above the bowl naming the ingredients. (3) The scene returns to a medium shot of the woman. She continues to eat and looks into the camera lens while speaking, gesturing occasionally with the hand holding the spoon. Yellow and white captions appear at the bottom center. (4) The video cuts to a final static screen with a white background. It features a large 'DRX' logo, the name '美上美皮膚科診所 DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC', and detailed contact information including a LINE ID, phone number, and two clinic addresses in New Taipei and Taipei cities.

A bright, mid-tempo acoustic-pop background music featuring a steady electronic beat and synth plucks enters immediately. (2) A female voice responds, listing ingredients with clear articulation and a friendly, informative tone. Small, high-pitched 'pop' or 'bubble' sound effects trigger each time an ingredient name appears on screen. (3) The female voice continues into a mini-lecture about digestive health and fiber, maintaining a consistent professional yet accessible pace. The BGM continues steadily underneath her speech. (4) The video concludes with a short, bright 'ding' synth stinger as the clinic information card is presented, followed by the music fading out quickly.
